options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, I(client_key) is not required

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If I(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: comment
options.description: The comment that describes the silence.

options.name: created_by
options.description: The author that creates the silence.

options.name: ends_at
options.description: ISO 8601 Timestamp with milliseconds  e.g. "2029-07-29T08:45:45.000Z" when the silence will end.

options.name: grafana_api_key
options.description: The Grafana API key. If set, C(url_username) and C(url_password) will be ignored.

options.name: matchers
options.description: List of matchers to select which alerts are affected by the silence.

options.name: org_id
options.description: The Grafana organization ID where the silence will be created or deleted. Not used when I(grafana_api_key) is set, because the grafana_api_key only belongs to one organization. Mutually exclusive with C(org_name).

options.name: org_name
options.description: The Grafana organization name where the silence will be created or deleted. Not used when I(grafana_api_key) is set, because the grafana_api_key only belongs to one organization. Mutually exclusive with C(org_id).

options.name: skip_version_check
options.description: Skip Grafana version check and try to reach api endpoint anyway. This parameter can be useful if you enabled `hide_version` in grafana.ini

options.name: starts_at
options.description: ISO 8601 Timestamp with milliseconds  e.g. "2029-07-29T08:45:45.000Z" when the silence starts.

options.name: state
options.description: Delete the first occurrence of a silence with the same settings. Can be "absent" or "present".

options.name: url_password
options.description: The Grafana password for API authentication.

options.name: url_username
options.description: The Grafana user for API authentication.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(false), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(false) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
